verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found that the e-FRRO root returns HTTP 200, but a keyless agent converting the page to text gets only 12 characters, so the public reading surface is effectively unreadable. The long-published guidance entry path (/eservices/home.jsp) now returns 404, so no readable guidance page was reached. Confidence is medium because the probe's metadata ('script tags absent') sits oddly with its description of a JavaScript application shell, though both point to an empty surface for agents.
